import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Set random seed for reproducibility
RANDOM_STATE = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)

# Paths
DATA_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Identify feature types and prepare data
# Based on data overview, f_27 is object (categorical), rest are numeric
X_train = train_df.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1)
y_train = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df.drop(["id"], axis=1)
test_ids = test_df["id"]

# Handle categorical feature 'f_27' for LightGBM
# Using category type for efficient handling
X_train["f_27"] = X_train["f_27"].astype("category")
X_test["f_27"] = X_test["f_27"].astype("category")

# Split training data into train and validation sets (stratified)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, stratify=y_train
)

# Define datasets for LightGBM
train_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_dataset)

# Define model parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "categorical_feature": ["f_27"],
    "seed": RANDOM_STATE,
}

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_dataset,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_dataset],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.5f}")

# Predict on test set and create submission
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": y_test_pred})
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
